responsibility: Implements the generator program that emits the RVV type-index table included by the vector builtin machinery. It enumerates valid integer, floating, and mask vector type combinations across SEW and LMUL, computes related same-ratio EEW, truncation, reinterpretation, and LMUL-extension relationships, and writes DEF_RVV_TYPE_INDEX entries used later to derive builtin type families and cross-type mappings for RVV intrinsics.
